body.name: Dimension-uniform joint certificate handle
body.construction:
Construct \(\mathfrak J(d,K,\lambda,L)\) by evaluating a localized polynomial \(Q_L\) for the full lower-overlap ratio maximum \(F_K(q)\) together with the exact second-moment cost of \(U_{Q_L}\). On the balanced comparison slice, reduce this object to the primal pair \(\mathcal E_K(P_L)^2+d^{-1}\mathcal W_{K,\lambda}(P_L)\) over \((c_\alpha:\alpha\in\mathcal A_{K,L})\), and match it to the dual pair \(\Delta_{\max}(
u_0,
u_1)^2\) and \(\mathfrak D_{K,\lambda}(
u_0,
u_1)\) over normalized moment-matched priors. Use exact semialgebraic decision on compact rational localization boxes to certify the primal continuous-domain inequalities, localize \(\lambda\) to empirical patient-group occupancy, and splice the cited \(K=2\), one-group, and saturation boundaries.
